desc: Read N, M, and the list P of length N; convert to ints.
Sort P in ascending order; initialize total_units = 0, remaining = M.
For each P_i in sorted list: compute cap = floor(sqrt(remaining // P_i)); if cap > 0, subtract cap^2 * P_i from remaining, add cap to total_units.
Use `from math import isqrt` for safe integer square root.
Ensure early break when `p > rem` to avoid unnecessary work.
Verify algorithm correctness with sample inputs.
Consider edge cases (N=1, M very large, large P_i).
Final solution is O(N log N) time, O(N) memory, and handles big integers.
